item.title: I built a bracket website and was wondering if you could check it out?
item.summary: I put together a tournament bracket site where I enlarged the images and integrated YouTube videos to make the matchups way more dynamic and engaging. Traffic has been a lot lower than I expected though. How does it look from a fellow developer's perspective, is it really that bad? www.picktourney.com Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49328982 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
